label: lem:interval_integrable_restriction
title: Interval integrability restriction
statement: Let $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ be interval integrable on $[a,b]$, and let $x \in \mathrm{Ioo}\;(\min\, a\, b)\;(\max\, a\, b)$. Then $f$ is interval integrable on $[a,x]$ (i.e.\ \texttt{IntervalIntegrable f volume a x}). This follows from \texttt{IntervalIntegrable.mono\_set} since $\texttt{uIcc}\; a\; x \subseteq \texttt{uIcc}\; a\; b$.
proof: Since $x \in \mathrm{Ioo}\;(\min\, a\, b)\;(\max\, a\, b) \subseteq [\min(a,b), \max(a,b)]$, the interval $\texttt{uIcc}\; a\; x$ is contained in $\texttt{uIcc}\; a\; b$. By monotonicity of interval integrability (\texttt{IntervalIntegrable.mono\_set}), integrability on $[a,b]$ implies integrability on $[a,x]$.
